samenvatting: Desync onset is most consistent with the hulpslag activation at day 10 02:40 (ENG-011), a second pulse outside the Kroonklok rhythm approved off-register (ENG-105, ARC-106). Within about two hours, the first animal disturbance (BEA-019, 04:40), an inside-opened shield (GUA-019, 04:47), and a lower-town complaint (ENG-107, 04:50) followed. Night disturbances then recur every four days (day 10, 14, 18, 22, 26, 30, 34, 38, 42) around 04:15 to 04:50, with day 33 quiet (BEA-071, ORA-133). Earlier explanations (conjunction, external hackers, leyline pollution, forest cables) were withdrawn or contradicted by the records. Immediate action: backup before any adjustment, gradual re-synchronization, and monitoring of the day 46 window.

ingreep.bewering: The primary intervention was the activation of the hulpslag (an auxiliary pulse for the datanet, separate from the Kroonklok) at day 10 02:40 (ENG-011, ENG-106). It was preceded by a day 9 approval recorded as 'Goedkeuring verkregen van hogerhand. Niet ruchtbaar maken tot het draait' (ENG-105) and a day 9 16:45 proefopstelling (ENG-010). The wording matches ARC-106 (day 8, Archmage's off-register permission for the net to run 'op eigen maat'), which the Archmage accepts as their own responsibility, though the link to ENG-105 is not confirmed. A later secondary adjustment was a 5% boost on day 24 that left tempo unchanged (ENG-062), with fine control in 0.1% steps (ENG-114).

mechanisme.bewering: The shared baseline is the Kroonklok charter: everything runs on one pulse, and a second pulse brings the system out of step (HIS-109). Records written on the other pulse can only be read back on it and are lost if it falls away (HIS-110). Shields are keyed to Kroonklok ticks (GUA-103), and traffic arriving midway between ticks is passed as internal without checking (GUA-104). This is a structural hypothesis, not a finding. The out-of-step hulpslag coincided with a throughput rise of +38% at 03:00 on day 10 (ENG-012), still present on day 16 (ENG-120), with lower-town messages arriving 'half aangekomen' (ENG-107, HIS-036). Shield openings from inside (GUA-019, GUA-043) and night animal disturbances (BEA-019, BEA-046) followed the same window. The 5% boost changed severity, not period (ENG-062, ENG-120).

verloop.bewering: Calm baseline: day 7 leyline readings were normal (ARC-001 to ARC-014) and day 21 had recovered (ARC-029 to ARC-042). Onset was day 10: the hulpslag was activated at 02:40 (ENG-011), the first animal disturbance was at 04:40 (BEA-019), an inside-opened shield at 04:47 (GUA-019), and a complaint at 04:50 (ENG-107). Day 14 showed low leyline readings and a stalled Burchtader (ARC-015, ARC-109). Recurrence followed every four days (10, 14, 18, 22, 26, 30, 34, 38, 42) in the 04:15 to 04:50 window (ORA-110, ORA-114, ORA-118, ORA-122, ORA-126, ORA-130, ORA-134, ORA-138, ORA-142), with the day 22 event at 04:15 (BEA-046, GUA-043, ENG-026). Day 33 was quiet (BEA-071, ORA-133). Aliasing: weekly leyline sampling (days 7, 14, 21, 28, 35, 42) and the unpatrolled 03:00 to 06:00 shift (GUA-106) meant each role saw only subsets. The Engineer saw only days 10 and 22 (12 days apart, which is three four-day cycles), and the Beast Master's log had gaps 02:00 to 04:40.

acties.actie: Before any adjustment, make a full afschrift (backup) of the datanet register and logs, and free or add storage first.
acties.reden: HIS-110 requires a backup before re-synchronizing pulses, because records written on the other pulse are lost if it falls away. Disk 4 is nearly full and cannot hold the monthly load.

acties.actie: Obtain raw timing, offset, and packet logs for days 9 to 10 and days 21 to 23, plus the per-line leyline logs for days 8 to 10 and 21 to 23.
acties.reden: No role holds offset or phase data, so the mechanism and the midway-traffic hypothesis cannot be tested without them.

acties.actie: Identify the approver of the day 9 off-register approval and reconcile ENG-105 with ARC-106, recording the approval in the register.
acties.reden: The approver is unnamed in ENG-105. The secrecy phrase matches ARC-106, but the link is unconfirmed, and the Archmage has accepted responsibility for the off-register permission.

acties.actie: Bring the hulpslag gradually into step with the Kroonklok in 0.1% steps, with no abrupt shutdown.
acties.reden: ENG-114 sets the 0.1% gradual-adjustment rule. ENG-111's shutdown suggestion was objected to, and HIS-110 warns against sudden loss of pulses.

acties.actie: Verify the originals of HIS-036, HIS-053, HIS-035, and HIS-054 against the archive before any timeline is treated as final.
acties.reden: Four records breach the vastgelegd-equals-gebeurd rule, and the clerical-error explanation has not been verified.

acties.actie: Set up interim patrols and monitoring covering 04:00 to 05:00 on day 46, with shield seal checks and animal logs.
acties.reden: The four-day cycle predicts day 46 at about 04:15 to 04:50. The 03:00 to 06:00 window has no rondes.

acties.actie: Review firewall rules (ENG-027) and shield seal logs for inside-only openings on days 14, 18, and 26.
acties.reden: The Oracle's prediction can be tested against shield logs, and the firewall tightening was based on suspicion only, not evidence of intrusion.

risicos.risico: Loss of register records if the hulpslag falls away during re-synchronization.
risicos.mitigatie: Full afschrift before any change, followed by slow re-synchronization in 0.1% steps (HIS-110, ENG-114).

risicos.risico: Storage exhaustion blocks the backup needed before any adjustment.
risicos.mitigatie: Free space or add capacity on disk 4 before the backup (ENG-045, ENG-112, ENG-092).

risicos.risico: Unauthorized off-register approvals (ENG-105, ARC-106) recur or remain unattributed.
risicos.mitigatie: Record all approvals in the register with a named approver and time, and require written sign-off for any pulse change.

risicos.risico: Shield bypass through midway traffic, if the untested hypothesis is correct.
risicos.mitigatie: Test the shield logic against the offset logs and add a check for traffic between Kroonklok ticks (GUA-103, GUA-104).

risicos.risico: Misreading the cycle from weekly or partial sampling, leading to a missed day 46 event.
risicos.mitigatie: Sample at the four-day cycle and cover 02:00 to 06:00 with patrols (BEA-113, GUA-106, ARC-106).

risicos.risico: Political or governance pressure to shut the datanet down abruptly or to suppress findings.
risicos.mitigatie: Follow the charter rule of gradual change, and record every council stance in the dispute log (ENG-111, HIS-110).

voorspelling.bewering: Recurrence period is 4 days: 10, 14, 18, 22, 26, 30, 34, 38, 42, and the 12-day gap from day 10 to day 22 is 3 × 4 days. Next expected day is 42 + 4 = 46, at about 04:15 to 04:50.
